protocol.previous_mask: recorded pre_mask, identical for all groups
protocol.decoder: same original Mask Decoder, trainable in E0-E3 with identical lr/loss
protocol.E4: paired test-time shuffling of E3, same checkpoint; recipient clicks/types/masks fixed
protocol.NoC@90: complete five-click recorded prefixes only; failure 6; not a closed-loop click simulator
protocol.Boundary IoU: original resolution; inner boundary with distance=round(0.02*image_diagonal)
protocol.spatial_alignment: original normalized viewport/path -> resized unpadded image -> SAM padded canvas
